newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says may buy 20 Russian Su-30 fighters.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says may buy 20 Russian Su-30 fighters.

text.p: Indonesia's air force is keen to buy as many as 20 Russian Sukhoi Su-30 fighter aircraft after a deal to buy nine American F-16 jets fell through, the official Antara news agency said on Tuesday.

"From the four kinds of warplanes we have surveyed, we prefer to buy the most economical and efficient with the longest combat radius, namely the Sukhoi Su-30 from Russia," Antara quoted air force chief of staff Air Marshall Sutria Tubagus as saying.
"We don't have to worry about spare parts. Surely it will not be difficult for us to obtain spare parts for the Sukhoi Su-30 as Russia badly needs additional foreign exchange," he said.
Tubagus said the air force ideally needed at least one squadron, as many as 20 aircraft, so they could be sent to two trouble spots at the same time.
Indonesia has examined the Russian MiG-29 Fulcrum, the Sukhoi Su-27, the Sukhoi Su-30 as well as the French Mirage-2000 and the JAS-39 Grippen from Sweden.
Indonesia cancelled a deal to buy F-16s after criticism of its human rights record by the U.S. Congress.
The planned purchase of new aircraft would not alter an existing contract to buy 40 British Aerospace Hawk-100/200 jets, 24 of which have been delivered.
